```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # PowerShell 7.x is pre‑installed on windows‑latest, but we can
      # explicitly install it if needed.  The official action is
      # `actions/setup-powershell@v1`, which is available in the
      # marketplace.
      - name: Setup PowerShell 7.4
        uses: actions/setup-powershell@v1
        with:
          version: '7.4'

      - name: Install Azure CLI
        uses: azure/setup-azure-cli@v1

      - name: Install Bicep CLI
        run: az bicep install

      - name: Verify Bicep build
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.bicep | ForEach-Object {
            Write-Host "Building $($_.FullName)"
            az bicep build --file $_.FullName
          }

      - name: Run Build-Toolkit
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .\Build-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Run Package-Toolkit
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          .\Package-Toolkit.ps1

      - name: Verify metadata files copied
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $releaseDir = ".\release"
          if (-Not (Test-Path $releaseDir)) { throw "Release directory not found" }
          $metadataFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $releaseDir -Recurse -Filter metadata.bicep
          if ($metadataFiles.Count -eq 0) { throw "No metadata.bicep files found in release output" }
          Write-Host "Found $($metadataFiles.Count) metadata.bicep files in release output"
```
